text: The Committee Administrator, City Clerk's Office will give a presentation and training session on Board of Health meeting processes. The Board of Health may meet in closed session on this item in accordance with the provisions of the City of Toronto Act, 2006 which permits the closing of a meeting for the education or training of the Directors.
The Board of Health: 1. Received the presentation (June 30, 2023) from the Committee Administrator, City Clerk's Office for information.
